duplicateCandidateReviews.reason: Warrior I faces the hips forward in a staggered stance; Warrior II opens the hips and arms sideways.
One-arm and simultaneous two-arm seated kickbacks have different unilateral versus bilateral execution.
Pronated and supinated single-arm elbow extensions deliberately retain distinct forearm grips.
Decline and incline leverage machines press downward versus upward relative to the supported torso.
One-arm and two-arm supine throws use different throwing support and laterality.
Palms-down and palms-up single-arm wrist curls train opposite wrist actions.
Single-hand versus two-hand landmine grip changes support and unilateral loading.
External and internal band rotation move the forearm outward versus across the abdomen.
Seated rear-delt fly uses cable tension versus dumbbells; required resistance apparatus differs.
Bilateral wrist extension is distinct from separately performed one-arm wrist extension.
Floor pressing is horizontal with upper-arm floor support; standing alternating press is overhead.
Seated versus standing hip-hinged unilateral kickbacks have distinct body support.
Barbell and independent dumbbell shoulder protraction require different implements.
Paused box squat uses a seat support; chain squat has no box pause or seat.
Bilateral wrist flexion is distinct from separately performed one-arm wrist flexion.
Barbell rack loading versus dumbbells at the sides changes required apparatus and load position.
Straight-bar and independent-dumbbell stiff-knee hinges require different implements.
Straight-bar pronated grip and neutral rope attachment are explicitly retained distinct pulldown variants.
Conventional-width reverse-band deadlift and wide sumo stance have distinct stance/arm placement.
Hip-hinged kickback holds upper arm by the torso; upright overhead extension holds it above the head.
High-to-front cable crossover and low-to-high crossover use different pulley paths.
Banded squat to a box includes a supported pause; the free banded squat has no box.
Prone loaded neck extension and supine loaded neck flexion use opposite body orientation and motion.
Bilateral palms-down wrist extension differs from palms-up wrist flexion.
Dumbbell overhead elbow extension differs from stepping forward against a loaded sled attachment.
Conventional and wide sumo chain deadlifts retain different stance and arm placement.
Narrow hack squat uses a back-supported machine; narrow back squat uses a free barbell and rack.
Standard kettlebell snatch receives with feet under the body; split snatch receives in a split stance.
Kettlebell push jerk re-bends both knees under the body; split jerk receives with one foot forward.
Flat and decline wide-grip barbell bench presses have distinct supported torso angles.
Flat and incline Smith bench presses have distinct supported torso angles.
Supine bench knee pull-in keeps the trunk supported; seated bench tuck moves the trunk toward the knees.
Supinated EZ-bar preacher curl and reverse pronated preacher curl deliberately retain distinct grips.
Supported heel-to-toe walking uses a wall; the original walk is unsupported.
Floor close-grip push-up and bench-elevated close-grip push-up have different hand supports and demand.
Side-to-side push-up shifts load laterally; push-up-to-side-plank rotates onto one supporting hand.
Single kettlebell floor press differs from a one-hand balanced barbell floor press requiring partner setup.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Set the bench and rack safeties before lifting. Lie with feet planted, hands slightly wider than shoulders, and shoulder blades supported.
Unrack the bar over the chest. Lower it under control to a comfortable chest-level position.
Press back to the starting position, then return the bar securely to the rack after the set.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected instructions: Bench/rack, chest compound and rep/load contract fit; rack setup must precede movement. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set the bench to a comfortable incline and plant both feet. Hold the dumbbells beside the upper chest.
Press the dumbbells above the upper chest without flaring the ribs, then lower them under control to the starting position.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected instructions: Incline bench distinguishes flat pressing; describe pressing above the upper chest rather than an overhead shoulder press. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Secure your legs on a decline bench and set appropriate rack safeties.
Lower the bar toward the lower chest, then press to the starting position.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Stand between cable handles with a stable staggered stance and softly bent elbows.
Bring the hands together in front of the chest, then reopen without forcing the shoulders behind you.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Machine
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles sit around chest height.
Bring the arms together with a soft elbow bend, then return slowly to a comfortable range.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells above the chest and elbows slightly bent.
Open the arms to a comfortable depth, then bring the weights together without changing the elbow bend.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Push-up
instructions: Place hands under or just outside the shoulders and form a straight line from head to heels.
Bend the elbows to lower the chest, then press the floor away without letting the hips sag.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Merged Pushups (Close and Wide Hand Positions): This row merely offers close or wide hand positions for otherwise ordinary push-ups; both variants already have dedicated entries. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Chest Dip
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with shoulders held down.
Lean slightly forward, lower through a comfortable elbow bend, and press back up without bouncing at the bottom.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles align with the middle of the chest.
Keep the back supported as you press forward and return under control.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Lie with your full back supported on a bench and hold one dumbbell above the chest.
Keeping a soft elbow bend, lower it overhead only as far as you can without arching the lower back, then return.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected metadata.secondaryMuscles: Supported dumbbell shoulder-extension movement also recruits lats, missing from supporting anatomy. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Pull-up
instructions: Take an overhand grip on a secure pull-up bar.
Pull the elbows down until the chin clears the bar comfortably, then lower with control without swinging.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Chin-up
instructions: Take an underhand grip on a secure bar and begin from a controlled hang.
Pull the elbows toward the ribs to raise the chin, then lower without kicking.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Secure the thigh pad and grip the overhead bar.
Pull the bar toward the upper chest while keeping the torso mostly still, then let the arms extend under control.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected metadata.equipment: Instructions require an actual seated pulldown station with thigh restraint, not only any cable pulley. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge at the hips with knees softly bent and a steady trunk.
Pull the bar toward the lower ribs, pause, and lower without jerking the torso upward.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Secure the bar in a landmine attachment and fit a compatible close-grip rowing handle around the loaded end.
Straddle the bar, hinge at the hips and grasp the handle with both hands.
Draw the handle toward the lower ribs, then lower while keeping the trunk still.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected metadata.equipment: Landmine anchoring is explicit but a compatible close-grip rowing handle is also required.; Corrected instructions: Landmine anchoring is explicit but a compatible close-grip rowing handle is also required. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit tall with feet braced and knees softly bent.
Pull the handle toward the lower ribs, then reach forward under control without rounding or rocking the torso.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected metadata.equipment: Braced feet and seated pulley setup require a seated cable-row station. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Brace one hand on a stable bench and hold a dumbbell in the other hand with the back steady.
Pull the dumbbell toward the hip, then lower until the arm extends without twisting the trunk.
Complete the target repetitions with each arm; the entered rep count applies to each side.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected instructions: Unilateral bench-supported row has per-side=true; clarify that target reps apply to each arm. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Straight-Bar Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: Face a high cable pulley fitted with a straight bar. Grasp it with a comfortable overhand grip, step back and keep the elbows softly extended.
Move at the shoulders to draw the bar toward the thighs, keeping the elbow angle and torso steady.
Return the arms overhead under control without letting the weight pull the back into an arch.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected name.; Corrected instructions. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Machine Row
instructions: Adjust the machine so the handles are reachable with the chest supported.
Pull the handles toward the ribs and return slowly without lifting off the pad.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Back Extension
instructions: Adjust the pad below the hip crease and brace the legs.
Hinge forward at the hips, then return until the trunk is in line with the legs without leaning backward.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected metadata.secondaryMuscles: Instructions describe hip extension with neutral spine; add glute and hamstring support rather than imply isolated lower-back movement. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Barbell Squat
instructions: Set the rack safeties and place the bar securely across the upper back.
Brace, bend the hips and knees to a comfortable depth, and stand by pressing through the whole foot.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Merged Speed Squats: The reviewed setup and range are the same barbell back squat; a faster concentric intention and lighter prescription are programming choices, not a different identity. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Front Squat
instructions: Support the bar on the front shoulders with elbows lifted and safeties set.
Sit between the hips while keeping the torso tall, then stand without allowing the elbows to drop.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Leg Press
instructions: Adjust the seat to keep the lower back supported throughout the movement.
Lower the sled through a comfortable knee bend, then press away without locking the knees forcefully.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Place the rear foot on a stable bench and set the front foot far enough forward for balance.
Lower straight down through a comfortable range, then push through the front foot to stand.
Complete the target repetitions on each leg; the entered rep count applies to each side.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected metadata.difficulty: Rear-foot elevation creates greater balance demand than introductory split squat; use intermediate classification and explicit each-leg reps.; Corrected instructions: Rear-foot elevation creates greater balance demand than introductory split squat; use intermediate classification and explicit each-leg reps. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Step forward into a split stance and bend both knees to a comfortable depth.
Push through the front foot to take the next step, keeping the trunk tall and alternating legs.
Count each completed lunge step as one repetition; the entered count is the total across both legs.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected instructions: Alternating walking lunge must explicitly define existing non-per-side target as total steps across both legs. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
instructions: Align the machine pivot with the knees and position the shin pad above the ankles.
Extend the knees without swinging, then lower slowly.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with the bar over the middle of the feet.
Hinge and bend the knees to grip it, brace the trunk, then stand with the bar close to the legs; reverse the movement to lower.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold the bar near the thighs with knees softly bent.
Push the hips back while keeping the bar close, then drive the hips forward to stand before the back begins to round.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
instructions: Take a wide stance with toes turned out and grip the bar inside the knees.
Brace and push the floor away to stand, then lower with the bar close to the body.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down on a leg-curl machine. Align the knees with its pivot and position the ankle pad above the heels.
Curl the heels toward the hips without lifting the pelvis, then return slowly.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected name: Current name permits multiple machine positions; specify lying position because heels-to-hips/no-pelvis-lift instructions describe a prone curl.; Corrected metadata.aliases: Current name permits multiple machine positions; specify lying position because heels-to-hips/no-pelvis-lift instructions describe a prone curl. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Press through the feet to lift the hips until the trunk and thighs align, then lower without arching the lower back.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected metadata.secondaryMuscles: Floor hip extension uses optional load and dynamic reps; add hamstrings as support without duplicating Pilates identity. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Support the upper back on a stable bench and pad the bar across the hips.
Drive through the feet to extend the hips, keeping the ribs down, then lower under control.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand tall with feet about hip width apart.
Rise onto the balls of the feet, pause, and lower the heels slowly while keeping the ankles aligned.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Set the machine pads comfortably above the knees and place the balls of the feet on its platform.
Raise the heels, pause, then lower through a controlled comfortable range.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
instructions: Set a barbell in a rack near shoulder height. Take a grip just outside shoulder width, brace the trunk, and step back with the bar at the front of the shoulders.
Press overhead while keeping the ribs down and moving the head just enough to let the bar pass.
Lower to the front of the shoulders without leaning back, then return the bar to the rack after the set.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected metadata.equipment: Standing barbell shoulder press needs an explicit start from rack to avoid implying an unprescribed clean.; Corrected instructions: Standing barbell shoulder press needs an explicit start from rack to avoid implying an unprescribed clean. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Stand with feet about hip width apart and hold the dumbbells beside the shoulders, with wrists stacked over elbows.
Press both dumbbells overhead without arching the back, then lower under control.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Merged Standing Dumbbell Press: Both describe a strict bilateral dumbbell overhead press without leg drive; no distinct apparatus or position remains.; Corrected instructions: Standing dumbbell press is intended; specify standing to remove ambiguity against imported seated variants. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
instructions: Stand with a steady trunk and dumbbells in front of the shoulders, palms facing you.
Rotate the palms forward as you press up, then reverse slowly through a comfortable shoulder range.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected metadata.difficulty: Rotational dumbbell pressing is a distinct variant; specify standing and intermediate coordination requirement.; Corrected instructions: Rotational dumbbell pressing is a distinct variant; specify standing and intermediate coordination requirement. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall with softly bent elbows and dumbbells by the sides.
Lift the arms out to about shoulder height, then lower without shrugging or swinging.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Merged Power Partials: Despite its title, the instructions raise both dumbbells to shoulder height; they describe the existing lateral raise rather than a partial-range variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Front Raise
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of the thighs, with the trunk steady.
Raise both arms together in front to about shoulder height, then lower slowly without leaning back.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected instructions: Bilateral dumbbell shoulder flexion is distinct from lateral raise; clarify both arms move together. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
instructions: Face the machine pad and adjust the handles to shoulder height.
Open the arms outward through a comfortable range, then return without shrugging.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected metadata.secondaryMuscles: Supported reverse fly targets rear shoulders; add upper-back supporting musculature. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Face Pull
instructions: Set a rope attachment around face height.
Pull toward the face with elbows moving outward and shoulder blades controlled, then return slowly without leaning back.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected metadata.secondaryMuscles: Rope face pull is a cable pulling movement; upper-back support was omitted from anatomy. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Upright Row
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of the thighs.
Raise them close to the body with elbows leading only through a comfortable shoulder range, then lower without shrugging.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected metadata.secondaryMuscles: Upright row uses elbow flexion; replace copied triceps support with biceps/traps. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Barbell Shrugs
instructions: Stand with the bar at the thighs and arms straight.
Lift the shoulders toward the ears without rolling them, pause, and lower slowly.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Normalized the broad muscle group; detailed anatomy remains in primary/secondary muscle tags. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand beside a low cable and hold its handle in the hand farther from the pulley.
Raise the arm sideways to a comfortable height, then lower slowly.
Complete the target repetitions with each arm; the entered count applies to each side.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected instructions: Unilateral cable raise fits per-side=true; explicitly tie entered reps to each arm. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Barbell Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand tall with an underhand grip on the bar.
Bend the elbows while keeping the upper arms near the sides, then lower without swinging the torso.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand tall with dumbbells beside the thighs.
Curl one arm while turning the palm upward, lower with control, and alternate arms without swinging.
Count each completed arm curl as one repetition; the entered count is the total across both arms.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected instructions: Alternating supinating curl needs explicit total-arm-rep convention because existing per-side is false. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand and palms facing inward.
Curl both weights together without moving the upper arms forward, then lower slowly while keeping the same grip.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected metadata.secondaryMuscles: Neutral-grip curl is distinct from supinating curl; add forearm support and specify simultaneous arms.; Corrected instructions: Neutral-grip curl is distinct from supinating curl; add forearm support and specify simultaneous arms. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Rest the upper arms fully on the preacher pad.
Curl the dumbbells without lifting the arms from the pad, then extend the elbows through a comfortable range.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Cable Bicep Curl
instructions: Face a low cable with an underhand grip.
Curl the handle while keeping the elbows near the sides, then lower under control.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with feet apart and rest the upper arm against the inner thigh.
Curl the dumbbell without moving the shoulder, then lower slowly.
Complete the target repetitions with each arm; the entered count applies to each side.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected instructions: Seated thigh-braced unilateral curl requires bench; clarify each-arm counting. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Tricep Rope Pushdown
instructions: Stand facing a high cable with a rope attachment and elbows beside the ribs.
Straighten the elbows to press the rope down, then return without moving the upper arms.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Skullcrushers
instructions: Lie on a bench with a light bar above the chest.
Bend the elbows to lower the bar toward a comfortable point near the forehead, then extend the elbows without letting the shoulders drift.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
instructions: Stand with feet about hip width apart and hold one dumbbell securely overhead with both hands.
Bend the elbows to lower it behind the head through a comfortable range, then extend without arching the back.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected instructions: One dumbbell held in both hands is bilateral overhead triceps extension; specify standing position. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand. Hinge forward with the back steady and upper arms beside the torso.
Straighten both elbows together to move the dumbbells behind you, then bend them slowly without swinging.

aliases: Standing Bent-Over Two-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension

Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or cli

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a bench with a grip around shoulder width and safeties set.
Lower the bar to the chest while keeping the elbows comfortably near the body, then press up.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Tricep Dip
instructions: Support the body on parallel bars with an upright torso.
Bend the elbows through a comfortable depth, then press back to support without shrugging or bouncing.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Wrist Curl
instructions: Kneel facing a bench, holding a dumbbell in each hand. Rest the forearms on the bench with palms upward and wrists just beyond the edge.
Curl both wrists through a small controlled range, then lower the dumbbells slowly.

aliases: Palms-Up Dumbbell Wrist Curl Over A Bench

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected instructions: Bilateral palms-up dumbbell wrist flexion explicitly requires forearm support; clarify kneeling at bench. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Kneel facing a bench, holding a dumbbell in each hand. Rest the forearms on the bench with palms downward and wrists just beyond the edge.
Lift the backs of both hands, then lower through a small controlled range.

aliases: Palms-Down Dumbbell Wrist Curl Over A Bench

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected instructions: Palms-down wrist extension distinguishes wrist curl; clarify bench approach and dumbbells in both hands. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet on the floor.
Curl the shoulder blades slightly up while keeping the neck relaxed, then lower under control.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected metadata.secondaryMuscles: Small spinal curl keeps feet down; remove hip-flexor support copied from full sit-up/leg-raise patterns. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Plank
instructions: Place the forearms under the shoulders and extend the legs.
Keep a straight line through the trunk, breathe steadily, and end the hold before the hips sag or the back arches.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected metadata.secondaryMuscles: Forearm plank is a timed isometric; add shoulder supporting role while preserving duration/optional-load contract. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Hang from a secure bar with a steady grip and shoulders controlled.
Keeping the legs mostly straight, raise them forward through a controlled range without swinging.
Lower slowly to the starting hang; one raise and return counts as one repetition.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected instructions: Hanging straight-leg raise should not simultaneously describe bent-knee progression under the same identity. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
instructions: Kneel with both hands on an ab wheel.
Roll forward only as far as you can keep the ribs and pelvis aligned, then return without allowing the lower back to sag.

review.method: AI editorial review: retain. Retained this apparatus/position and measurement variant. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit with knees bent and heels grounded.
Lean back slightly with the spine long and rotate the chest a little to one side, then the other, keeping the movement controlled.
Count each turn to one side as one repetition; the entered count is the total across both directions.

review.method: AI editorial review: repair. Corrected instructions: Grounded-heel seated rotation needs explicit total alternating-side rep count. Editable SpotBot dose; not trainer or clinical validation.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back and lift the shoulder blades gently.

exercises.name: Clean
instructions: With a barbell on the floor close to the shins, take an overhand (or hook) grip just outside the legs. Lower your hips with the weight focused on the heels, back straight, head facing forward, chest up, with your shoulders just in front of the bar. This will be your starting position.

Begin the first pull by driving through the heels, extending your knees. Your back angle should stay the same, and your arms should remain straight. Move the weight with control as you continue to above the knees.

Next comes the second pull, the main source of acceleration for the clean. As the bar approaches the mid-thigh position, begin extending through the hips. In a jumping motion, accelerate by extending the hips, knees, and ankles, using speed to move the bar upward. There should be no need to actively pull through the arms to accelerate the weight; at the end of the second pull, the body should be fully extended, leaning slightly back, with the arms still extended.

As full extension is achieved, transition into the third pull by aggressively shrugging and flexing the arms with the elbows up and out. At peak extension, aggressively pull yourself down, rotating your elbows under the bar as you do so. Receive the bar in a front squat position, the depth of which is dependent upon the height of the bar at the end of the third pull. The bar should be racked onto the protracted shoulders, lightly touching the throat with the hands relaxed. Continue to descend to the bottom squat position, which will help in the recovery.
Immediately recover by driving through the heels, keeping the torso upright and elbows up. Continue until you have risen to a standing position.
